title: atractylodes chinensis var. simplicifolia
intro: Atractylodes chinensis var. simplicifolia, commonly known as Bai Zhu, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) and is native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to warm the middle jiao, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Bai Zhu include tonifying the Spleen Qi, resolving dampness and phlegm, and promoting the movement of Qi. The bioactive constituents of Bai Zhu include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
